consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1988-09-18 show at Madison Square Garden was a fun and energetic performance, with standout moments in the first and second sets. The crowd's enthusiasm, especially during the 'Not Fade Away' chant, contributed to the overall positive vibe of the concert.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 17 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the energy and specific performances, there were also critiques regarding the overall quality and consistency of the show.
